# ”Mycket ränteoro men börsen är inte sur"

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covers US rate worries: the 10-year Treasury yield is above 5%, its highest since 2007. Oil is near $110 and a Fed rate hike is widely expected at tomorrow's meeting, yet stocks are holding up because corporate earnings remain strong. AI-risk comments hit memory and chip stocks while lifting IT-security names, and Bank of America's warning about weaker investment-banking revenue weighed on US banks. The only notable Swedish company story was Hemnet, where Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock while lowering its price target after a roughly 20% slide.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Morgan Stanley raised its recommendation but cut its target. Stock down about 20% after the buyback pause. One speaker said it will become a good buy once new owners clean up.

#### Reasoning

This view comes from a cited analyst plus a loose host remark. Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock while cutting its target after a roughly 20% drop, and a host thinks it will become a buy once the new owners have cleaned up. But the latest figures were weak, the board, guidance and business model are all new, and high short interest makes moves bigger. The turnaround case is speculative, so this is a watch rather than a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further weak operating figures
- if the business model change fails
- if the buyback is not resumed or its pause signals deeper problems

> *"Ni gamla ägare ska städa upp. Det här kommer bli bra köpämne."*
